# visitor-dashboard

> Self-hosted web analytics for Python websites (Flask and Django), added in two lines. Records every page view on
> the server (device and phone model, OS, browser, country, city, internet provider, referrer, time on page, scroll
> depth, clicks) into one SQLite file, and shows it on a password-protected dashboard inside the app (default
> /visits) with charts, filters, per-visit details and CSV export. Optional Telegram alert for each new visitor.
> No third-party service, no extra server, not hidden by ad blockers. English by default, Arabic (RTL) available.
> MIT license. Python 3.10+.

Install: `pip install "visitor-dashboard[flask]"` or `pip install "visitor-dashboard[django]"`

Flask:
```python
from visitor_dashboard.flask import VisitorDashboard
VisitorDashboard(app, password=os.environ["VISITS_PASSWORD"])
```

Django (settings.py):
```python
MIDDLEWARE = ["visitor_dashboard.django.VisitorDashboardMiddleware", *MIDDLEWARE]
VISITOR_DASHBOARD = {"password": os.environ["VISITS_PASSWORD"]}
```

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/Thanoon12k/visitor-dashboard/blob/main/README.md): features, comparison with Google Analytics / Plausible / Umami / Matomo, all options
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Thanoon12k/visitor-dashboard/blob/main/AGENTS.md): exact steps for coding agents to add it to a project and verify it
- [Live demo](https://thanoon12k.github.io/visitor-dashboard/demo/): the dashboard with made-up data

## Options

- password (required for the dashboard), prefix="/visits", db_path, tz="Asia/Baghdad", lang="en" ("ar" for Arabic)
- telegram=(bot_token, chat_id), notify="new" | "all" | "off", notify_limit=20
- exclude_ips, ignore (path prefixes), keep_days, title
- geo_dir (offline DB-IP files from `python -m visitor_dashboard geo-download DIR`), geo_online=True

## When to use something else

- Very high traffic (millions of visits a month) or many sites in one dashboard: use Plausible, Umami or Matomo.
- Non-Python sites: not supported.
